source.title: Custom Roles and Permissions

evidence_level: Documented intent (PRD). Not implementation, not verified behaviour.

roles.name: Owner
roles.description_verbatim: Full system access, cannot be demoted

roles.name: Service Manager
roles.description_verbatim: Full operational access, limited admin (App Settings + Wages only)

roles.name: Senior Service Advisor
roles.description_verbatim: Work order and customer management with expanded access

roles.name: Service Advisor
roles.description_verbatim: Work order and customer management with invoicing access

roles.name: Technician
roles.description_verbatim: Assigned work orders and time tracking (Tech View)

roles.name: Office
roles.description_verbatim: Office administration, reporting, and back-office operations

roles.name: Sales Representative
roles.description_verbatim: Reports and financial data access only

permissions.label: Work Orders — View
permissions.controls_verbatim: See work orders in the work order list and open work order detail pages. If OFF, the Work Orders top level nav item is hidden.

permissions.label: Work Orders — Create and Edit
permissions.controls_verbatim: Create new work orders. Edit work order fields (customer, asset, service advisor, lead technician, status).

permissions.label: Work Orders — Delete
permissions.controls_verbatim: Delete work orders.

permissions.label: Review Work Orders
permissions.controls_verbatim: Gives the user the ability to see and review the work order. Without this setting, users will not see the Review option on work orders.

permissions.label: Pick Parts
permissions.controls_verbatim: Pick parts from inventory onto a work order line. Move parts between work orders. These are physical floor actions — grabbing a part from the shelf or moving a part from one WO to another.

permissions.label: Order Parts
permissions.controls_verbatim: Place a purchase order for parts needed on a work order. Creates a PO linked to the work order. Also controls receiving parts deliveries onto a work order.

permissions.label: Work Order Lines — Create and Edit
permissions.controls_verbatim: Add new lines, edit line details, move parts between lines, authorize lines, manage part requests on lines.

permissions.label: Work Order Lines — Delete
permissions.controls_verbatim: Remove lines from work orders.

permissions.label: Schedule — View
permissions.controls_verbatim: See the schedule/calendar page. View appointments and technician assignments. If OFF, the Schedule top level nav item is hidden. The schedule shows all technicians' appointments — there is no "own only" schedule filtering. The schedule is a shared resource that SAs/managers use to coordinate work across all techs.

permissions.label: Schedule — Create and Edit
permissions.controls_verbatim: Create and modify appointments, assign technicians to time slots, drag-and-drop scheduling.

permissions.label: Schedule — Delete
permissions.controls_verbatim: Remove appointments from the schedule.

permissions.label: Customer Management — View
permissions.controls_verbatim: See customer records, contacts, vehicles, and vehicle history. If OFF, the Customers top level nav item is hidden.

permissions.label: Customer Management — Create and Edit
permissions.controls_verbatim: Create new customers, edit customer information, manage contacts, manage vehicles. Note: sensitive fields on the Edit Customer modal are hidden unless "View and Manage AP/AR Data" is enabled (see below).

permissions.label: Customer Management — Delete
permissions.controls_verbatim: Delete customer records. Does NOT control deleting customer payments — that requires Invoicing: Delete.

permissions.label: Part Sales — View
permissions.controls_verbatim: View part sales records, part returns, and part-related transactions.

permissions.label: Part Sales — Create and Edit
permissions.controls_verbatim: Create part sales, create part returns, process part transactions.

permissions.label: Part Sales — Delete
permissions.controls_verbatim: Delete part sales and reverse part sales invoices.

permissions.label: Catalog and Inventory — View
permissions.controls_verbatim: Browse the parts catalog, view inventory levels and stock information, view parts history.

permissions.label: Catalog and Inventory — Create and Edit
permissions.controls_verbatim: Create and edit catalog entries, make inventory adjustments, manage stock levels.

permissions.label: Catalog and Inventory — Delete
permissions.controls_verbatim: Delete parts from the catalog.

permissions.label: Vendor and Order Management — View
permissions.controls_verbatim: View vendor records, purchase orders, deliveries, vendor transaction history, and part return requests.

permissions.label: Vendor and Order Management — Create and Edit
permissions.controls_verbatim: Create and edit vendors, create and manage purchase orders, manage deliveries, create vendor invoices. Includes returning parts to vendors or inventory.

permissions.label: Vendor and Order Management — Delete
permissions.controls_verbatim: Delete vendors, delete purchase orders, reverse vendor transactions.

permissions.label: Invoicing — View
permissions.controls_verbatim: View invoices directly from work orders and part sales. Access the Finance tab on work orders. If OFF (but See Financial Data is ON), users can still see pricing data on work orders but cannot access invoices directly from work orders or part sales.

permissions.label: Invoicing — Create and Edit
permissions.controls_verbatim: Create invoices, process payments directly from work orders and part sales, manage invoice fields.

permissions.label: Invoicing — Delete / Reverse
permissions.controls_verbatim: Reverse invoices, delete payments (including customer payments), void transactions.

permissions.label: Timesheets — View
permissions.controls_verbatim: View timesheets from work orders. If OFF, the Timesheets top level nav item is hidden. However, if the user has Reports ON they will still see the timesheet activities report. (Note: all users can always clock in/out regardless of this setting.)

permissions.label: Timesheets — Create and Edit
permissions.controls_verbatim: Edit timesheet entries, adjust hours, manage attendance records for all staff. This includes editing from the work order and the timesheet activities report.

permissions.label: Reports
permissions.controls_verbatim: User can access the Reports page and view all available reports (tech efficiency, service advisor analysis, requested parts, vendor expenses, WO statuses, inventory, work-in-progress, etc.).

permissions.label: Customer Portal
permissions.controls_verbatim: User can access and manage the customer-facing portal configuration.

permissions.label: Billing Portal
permissions.controls_verbatim: User can access and manage the billing portal.

permissions.label: Parts Department
permissions.controls_verbatim: The three Parts child areas become available and are controlled by their individual CRUD permissions. Parts Department top level nav section is visible.

permissions.label: Settings
permissions.controls_verbatim: User can access the Administration/Settings area. Which sub-sections they see depends on the sub-settings below.

permissions.label: App Settings
permissions.controls_verbatim: General application configuration — organization name, business info, locale, branding. Also covers Roles and Permissions management (creating/editing/deleting custom roles), Integrations management, and Staff/Workplaces management.

permissions.label: Service
permissions.controls_verbatim: Service-related configuration — labor types, canned lines, asset types, departments, bays.

permissions.label: Parts
permissions.controls_verbatim: Parts settings — pricing matrices, categories, parts-specific configuration.

permissions.label: Finance
permissions.controls_verbatim: Financial settings — tax configuration, payment settings, accounting integrations (including QuickBooks), payment methods.

permissions.label: Data Import
permissions.controls_verbatim: Data import tools — bulk import of customers, vehicles, parts, and other records.

permissions.label: View/Manage Wages
permissions.controls_verbatim: View and manage employee wage rates. This is sensitive data — typically limited to Owner, Admin, SM, or Office roles.

permissions.label: View Mode — Full View
permissions.controls_verbatim: Complete work order interface with all fields visible and editable (subject to CRUD permissions). Full parts request form with all fields. All workflow actions available (approve, review, split, etc.). The Estimate column on work order lines shows the actual estimate value.

permissions.label: View Mode — Tech View
permissions.controls_verbatim: Simplified work order interface designed for technicians. See restriction table below.

permissions.label: See Financial Data
permissions.controls_verbatim: User can see pricing, costs, margins, and financial columns throughout the app. This includes: labor rates on work order lines, parts pricing, total/labor/parts columns on work orders, cost and margin data on parts, and financial summaries.

permissions.label: View and Manage AP/AR Data
permissions.controls_verbatim: User can see accounts payable/receivable data: Unpaid Invoices tabs, Payments tabs, and Credits tabs on Customer and Vendor detail pages, AP/AR aging reports (AR Aging Summary, AR Aging Detail, AR Aging Collection, AP Aging Summary, AP Aging Detail, AP Unpaid Invoices), and can make bulk payments from the Unpaid Invoices tab. Also controls visibility of sensitive customer fields on the Edit Customer modal (Credit Terms, Credit Limit, Default Labor Rate, Default Shop Supplies, Min and Max, Taxes, PO is Required).

permissions.label: View History Logs
permissions.controls_verbatim: User can view history/audit logs wherever they appear in the app — work order history, part sales history, parts order history, and similar change logs.

rules.verbatim: System roles can be edited, with exceptions: **Office** and **Time Clock** roles cannot be edited. System roles cannot be deleted.

If **1+ users** are assigned: a **"Cannot Delete"** modal appears with the message: "This role is assigned to N user(s). Reassign them to another role before deleting." The delete/confirm button is **disabled** — the admin cannot proceed until all users are reassigned to a different role.

rules.section: Admin Pages — Financial Data Confirmation Modal
rules.verbatim: **Trigger:** User enables any Invoicing or Part Sales CRUD checkbox (View, Edit, or Delete) while See Financial Data is OFF.
Changing a user's role triggers a forced logout for the affected user. The new role takes effect when they log back in.
View Mode is a **UX simplification, not a security boundary**. A user in Tech View with Edit permissions still has edit access — they just see a simpler interface.
Every user can clock in and out regardless of Timesheets permissions.
Owner and Administrator are separate system roles.

change_log.change_verbatim: - Removed “Data model” table. This was an AI hallucination. There was no intent to suggest technical implementation. - RE data access vs feature access. Clarified in feature over and key decisions that these permissions control feature access, not data access. Core requirements did not need updatingl. - Removed AP/AR metrics settings per discussions offline

notes: PRD-only parent gates: "partsDepartment" and "settings" are role-editor parent toggles in the PRD. The implementation stores no permission for them; the comparison derives them from the child permissions a role holds.
View Mode is listed as "Full" for Sales Representative and Time Clock, roles with no Work Orders access; recorded exactly as the PRD states it.
